name: Healing Helps
verdict: GBP drove all 53 organic actions over 28 days (31 directions, 21 web clicks, 1 call), but GBP engagement dropped 50% in the last 7 days, likely due to reduced profile activity or seasonal search demand. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) recorded zero spend and zero leads, so reactivating at least one paid channel should be the immediate priority to generate trackable leads.

performance.verdict: All paid channels dark 28+ days; organic GBP the only lead signal, now fading.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days; CPL is undefined because no paid channel has been active at all.
GBP actions dropped 50% in the last 7 days; last 3 days (Aug 1–3) show 0 GBP actions vs 9 in the prior 3 days (Jul 29–31), confirming a real declining signal, not noise.
GA4 sessions up 14.58% week-over-week (avg ~7/day last 7d vs ~6/day prior), but 0 GA4 conversions recorded over 28 days — tracking or conversion goal may be broken.
GHL pipeline shows null — with 53 GBP actions over 28 days generating 1 recorded call, intake from organic touch points is not being captured in CRM at all.

suggestions.text: Verify and repair GA4 conversion goal firing; 185 sessions over 28 days with 0 conversions signals a broken event, not zero intent.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 185 sessions and 143 users over 28 days but 0 conversion events — the goal event is almost certainly misfiring or was never configured. Audit the conversion event setup in GA4 and confirm it fires on the thank-you or contact-confirmed page. Success is confirmed when at least 1 conversion event registers within 3 days of the fix. Target resolution by 2026-08-07.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery: if actions remain at 0 for another 3 days through Aug 7, escalate profile activity or flag seasonal demand drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (Aug 1–3), down from 9 actions in the prior 3-day window — a confirmed declining signal. No paid channel is active to compensate. Monitor daily GBP actions through Aug 7; if still at or near 0, escalate with a post or offer update to the profile. Success threshold is returning to ≥3 actions per day within the next check window.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 53 GBP actions and 1 logged call suggest CRM is not capturing organic inquiries; confirm call-tracking and form routing.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL pipeline data returned null despite 53 GBP actions over 28 days including 31 direction requests and 21 web clicks. Only 1 call was recorded, indicating organic interest is not converting into tracked CRM opportunities. Confirm that the GBP phone number routes through GHL call tracking and that any contact form on the site posts to GHL. Success is GHL showing at least 1 new opportunity within 7 days of the fix being live, by 2026-08-11.

headlines.text: Quiet week; no movement or completions
